title: Process images using Amazon Rekognition and IoT Core
description: Process images with Amazon Rekognition and detect if uploaded image contains Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample project demonstrates an event-driven example that sends an IoT core message for images uploaded to S3 when PPE is not found in the uploaded image.
